SELECT
    c.`state`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.`customerid`) AS `customer_count`,
    CAST(COUNT(o.`orderid`) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.`customerid`) AS `avg_orders_per_customer`
FROM `mysql.store`.`customers` AS c
LEFT JOIN `mysql.store`.`orders` AS o
    ON c.`customerid` = o.`customerid`
GROUP BY c.`state`
ORDER BY `customer_count` DESC
